copy_policy.include: all package source, tests, configs, scripts, documentation, runtime recipes, hand tests, checked-in release metadata, and the active IsingFold corpus-v4 source-release receipts

verification.algorithm: SHA-256 of the sorted per-file SHA-256 manifest using paths relative to the package root

monorepo_adaptations: tests/test_isingfold_bridge_e2e.py resolves the IsingFold root in both monorepo and historical sibling layouts
tests/test_isingfold_publication.py resolves the IsingFold root in both monorepo and historical sibling layouts
active corpus-v4 source-release receipts moved from runs/ to data/provenance/; legacy corpus-v2 runs remain excluded
the legacy training-snapshot verifier moved from scripts/ to tools/legacy_provenance/
the Track-A experiment-results collector was not retained
historical example commands no longer refer to sibling LAC workspaces

post_adaptation_verification.algorithm: SHA-256 of the sorted per-file SHA-256 manifest using paths relative to the package root
post_adaptation_verification.excluded_from_digest: IMPORT_PROVENANCE.json to avoid a self-referential hash

boundary: EmbedBench remains an independent publisher. IsingFold training and evaluation consume authenticated exports and do not import generator code.
